$comment: Reservoirs that keep their main river line on the map (pipeline:lakes); lines inside every other lake are removed. Keyed by HydroLAKES Hylak_id; river is the pipeline:named id the step finds as the lake's main river (it fails if they disagree). Names use OpenStreetMap spelling (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); evidence is a point inside the HydroLAKES polygon falling inside exactly one named OSM water=reservoir relation's bounds (cached Overpass response, pipeline:osm-names). The list follows the project owner's request of 2026-09-30 (El Chocón, Alicurá, Piedra del Águila, Arroyito and the remaining Limay reservoir).
